rows.grounds: compound adjective describing the situated forehead syllable mass
compound adjective describing worship by gods

items.question: What action involving a hundred thousand is prescribed once the forehead syllable mass is worshipped by gods?
premises: A hundred thousand is to be done
items.inference: The practitioner performs a hundred thousand after worshipping the forehead syllable mass.
uncertainties: Exact ritual referent of lakṣaṃ remains unclear
Syntactic relation of sura+arcite is not fully explicit
items.plain_english: Having worshipped the forehead syllable mass by gods, one performs a hundred thousand.
